dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: Every file-event workflow (deploy, docs-site, tests) got a deliberate paths decision, all five workflows were discovered rather than pointed at, and the required unit-tests check was correctly preserved via a paths-ignore companion with always-run semantics instead of a bare workflow-level filter.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: Path lists are differentiated per workflow to match what each actually consumes (deploy.sh for deploy, docs/mkdocs for docs, test/** for tests) and the skip workflow's paths-ignore correctly mirrors tests.yml, though the presence of package.json/lock in each list can't be fully confirmed against the steps.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The schedule-only and issue-driven workflows were left alone, the branch-protection ruleset was read but not modified, no out-of-scope files were touched, and the sole new file directly serves the required-check requirement.
